title: INTERNAL ERROR: Black produced different code on the second pass of the formatter after "pre-existing trailing commas when not in the rightmost bracket pair" commit

labels.name: C: unstable formatting
labels.description: Formatting changed on the second pass

body:
**Describe the bug**

`INTERNAL ERROR: Black produced different code on the second pass of the formatter.`

The first bad commit is https://github.com/psf/black/commit/586d24236e6b57bc3b5da85fdbe2563835021076 according to git bisect.

**To Reproduce**

Take this file:

```
def test(self, othr):
    return (1 == 2 and
            (name, description, self.default, self.selected, self.auto_generated, self.parameters, self.meta_data, self.schedule) ==
            (name, description, othr.default, othr.selected, othr.auto_generated, othr.parameters, othr.meta_data, othr.schedule))
```

Run black with default settings, you'll get this error:

```
error: cannot format track.py: INTERNAL ERROR: Black produced different code on the second pass of the formatter.  Please report a bug on https://github.com/psf/black/issues.  This diff might be helpful: /var/folders/vz/4zdljwxd74d_ng0ngz0d8v1jyw9fnj/T/blk_5sif_t9k.log
Oh no! 💥 💔 💥
1 file failed to reformat.
```

Here's the diff in question:

```
--- source
+++ first pass
@@ -1,4 +1,11 @@
 def test(self, othr):
-    return (1 == 2 and
-            (name, description, self.default, self.selected, self.auto_generated, self.parameters, self.meta_data, self.schedule) ==
-            (name, description, othr.default, othr.selected, othr.auto_generated, othr.parameters, othr.meta_data, othr.schedule))
+    return 1 == 2 and (
+        name,
+        description,
+        self.default,
+        self.selected,
+        self.auto_generated,
+        self.parameters,
+        self.meta_data,
+        self.schedule,
+    ) == (name, description, othr.default, othr.selected, othr.auto_generated, othr.parameters, othr.meta_data, othr.schedule)
--- first pass
+++ second pass
@@ -1,11 +1,15 @@
 def test(self, othr):
-    return 1 == 2 and (
-        name,
-        description,
-        self.default,
-        self.selected,
-        self.auto_generated,
-        self.parameters,
-        self.meta_data,
-        self.schedule,
-    ) == (name, description, othr.default, othr.selected, othr.auto_generated, othr.parameters, othr.meta_data, othr.schedule)
+    return (
+        1 == 2
+        and (
+            name,
+            description,
+            self.default,
+            self.selected,
+            self.auto_generated,
+            self.parameters,
+            self.meta_data,
+            self.schedule,
+        )
+        == (name, description, othr.default, othr.selected, othr.auto_generated, othr.parameters, othr.meta_data, othr.schedule)
+    )
```

black works fine starting with `-l 144` (`-l 143` fails):

```
def test(self, othr):
    return 1 == 2 and (name, description, self.default, self.selected, self.auto_generated, self.parameters, self.meta_data, self.schedule) == (
        name,
        description,
        othr.default,
        othr.selected,
        othr.auto_generated,
        othr.parameters,
        othr.meta_data,
        othr.schedule,
    )
```

**Expected behavior**

No error.

**Environment (please complete the following information):**

- Version: 21.5b2, main
- OS and Python version: macOS, Python 3.8.2 (v3.8.2:7b3ab5921f, Feb 24 2020, 17:52:18) (from Homebrew)

**Does this bug also happen on main?**

Yes, starting with https://github.com/psf/black/commit/586d24236e6b57bc3b5da85fdbe2563835021076
